The '''Pioku Border Wars''' were a series of regional conflicts that took place at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> in the vicinity of the [[Pioku system/Legends|Pioku system]], a part of the [[Trans-Jardeen sector/Legends|Trans-Jardeen sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] served with the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the conflict.<ref name="Death Star Coup" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pioku Border Wars were mentioned in "The Death Star Coup," an article authored by [[Jason Fry]] and published as part of the [[A Certain Point of View (department)|''A Certain Point of View'']] department in the [[Star Wars Insider Special Edition 2014|2014 Special Edition]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Death Star Coup" /> The issue was published on [[November 5]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/features/announcements/star-wars-insider-special-edition-2014|text=''Star Wars Insider'' Special Edition 2014}}</ref>
